result: VCN28 mode readback followed the Gemian last-client off/on cycle
pmic_sysfs_transport: The exact three-byte address input entered the pinned vendor driver's read branch. Four matching dmesg records say read PMU reg 0xa0c; no write record for that address was found in the retained post-cycle log. The sysfs store itself returns its input size even on a transport error, so the observed values and branch records are stronger than its return value.
radio_cycle: One finite ConnMan disable, HCI down, WMT Wi-Fi off/on, HCI up and ConnMan enable; device-side cleanup was armed. The script exited zero in the same boot with WLAN carrier 1 and hci0 UP RUNNING.
interpretation: In this working Gemian boot, the common last-client transition cleared VCN28 on-control bit 3 and the reverse transition restored it. The two source-clock fields stayed at their prior encoded value 3 throughout the samples.
limitations: These are four PMIC register instants in one reference-kernel cycle. They do not identify physical clock inputs, every other PMIC writer or retained client, electrical rail state, exclusive mainline handoff, or a safe new power sequence. The diagnostic is single-use and must not be replayed without a new decision-changing measurement.
